title: Monk
notes: Preserve the Monk native full skeleton (50 nodes, 6 pilot nodes) and 47 Monk-specific Tyz candidates as source inventories, NOT 47 new compulsory live skills.
First Sunset and native mastery from barehand breaks, kills and first foods stay separate from MXP global awards.
Step Assist after Fleet Footwork, not at rank one. Tool-free harvest tiers remain native permission unlocks.

Monk is absolute top of overall personal combat / survivability / movement / adaptability power hierarchy. No other tree can be comparable in all those domains at once. A specialist can rival Monk only in one or two designated niches.

Boss test should require true no-worn-equipment including armor and Curios and no melee/ranged weapons; the precise policy for consumables, cast implements and non-worn utility should be frozen with the encounter acceptance test. Do not revive rejected innate Spirit Bolt.

Balance all Monk total effects, including innate gear/Apotheosis-like affix substitutes, AGAINST a comparably progressed specialist wearing appropriately-tiered enchantable/Affixed armor, weapons/tools and Curios. Monk is not required to defeat the FULLY GEARED equivalent in overall effective power; it must be approximately competitive.
Maxed Monk noncombat sources target 85% of FULLY GEARED best comparable specialist, not 85% of innate Tyz bonus. Sea Luck explicitly 0.85× equipped Sea Luck.

Curios are explicitly legal on Monk. Ordinary noncombat/combat parity counts Monk+legal Curios versus fully enchanted/Affixed geared specialist+legal Curios; keep optional STRICT no-worn-items Guardian trial separately.

2026-11-15 OWNER UPDATE: capped comparable noncombat including true Luck is 85% of theoretically achievable, legality-checked all-in specialist maximum including final Curios; this supersedes prior 80% Sea Luck exception and practical percentile comparator.

source.label: Inner Fortune
source.effect: True personal Luck, targeting exactly 85% of the best legally attainable fully maxed AND GEARED Sea Dragon Luck, including all enchanted/Affixed/overcharged/socked armor, legal Curios and other permanent modifiers, with Monk legal Curios already included. Not Fortune/Looting.
notes: Luck is not Fortune/Looting; vanilla Luck baseline often zero; use true source-verified Luck attribute, not arbitrary percent of zero.
Tier percentages are a reference scale; capped *final* output ratio 85%-90% controls actual numeric slope and event behavior, not unlimited proc multipliers.
No worn equipment or weapons needed to activate Monk late innate skill; all other Monk gear restrictions continue.
Calibration subtracts source-verified Monk Curios contribution from 80/85% target, rather than adding Curios ON TOP of fully budgeted Monk innate skill.

source.label: Empty-Hand Paragon
source.effect: Final Monk combat ceiling: a fully mastered Monk must be able to defeat the actual Chaos Guardian alone with absolutely no worn armor, Curios or other worn equipment and no weapons. This is a complete-fight mastery requirement, not free damage immunity, skipping Guardian mechanics, or importing a new Monk projectile. The test must exercise all authentic combat phases, crystals/shields and hostile threats with pack-approved legal unarmed/Monk abilities.
source.external_gate: verified final native progression plus explicit late-game achievement
source.exception_reason: One-time capstone purchase rather than linear mana/stat rank; cooldowns/external milestones required
source.benchmark: Monk maxed must defeat real Chaos Guardian solo, no worn equipment and no weapons, using Monk-owned abilities and any expressly allowed ordinary resources; no reliance on other class-specific skills, external player help, a pre-killed boss, immortal cheese or boss bypass. Comparative balance is against appropriately progressed, fully geared other paths (enchantments, Apotheosis affixes, weapons/tools, armor and Curios all counted), not a naked specialist.

coverage.handler_or_gap: activation, existing attributes/procs; native late gates and resource costs
